# Architecture Diagrams

C4 model and business-flow diagrams for the AI Governance Review Service.

All diagrams live in a single multi-tab Draw.io file: **[components.drawio](./components.drawio)**.

| Tab | SVG Export | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Business Flow | [business-flow.svg](../assets/business-flow.svg) | Submit → AI evaluate → cycle until pass → gate review board |
| C4 Level 1 — System Context | [c4-1.svg](../assets/c4-1.svg) | Actors, the service, and external dependencies |
| C4 Level 2 — Container | [c4-2.svg](../assets/c4-2.svg) | Internal layers (API, Core, Services, Data) and interactions |
| C4 Level 3 — Component | [c4-3.svg](../assets/c4-3.svg) | Core processing component detail and data flow |
